hint: The exit mat is in the middle of the bottom wall. Walk down onto it and walk_down once more. The rival challenges you on the way out; that battle is expected.
heading: down

text: Leave Pallet Town north onto Route 1.
hint: The north exit is a two-tile gap in the top tree line, north of the open ground between the two houses. Walk to it, then straight up. Do not walk south into the water.
heading: up

text: Walk north through Route 1 to Viridian City.
hint: Route 1 runs straight north to Viridian City. Ledges only drop south.
heading: up

text: Enter the Viridian Poké Mart; the clerk has a parcel for Oak.
hint: The Mart is the building with the blue roof. The old man blocks the north road until Oak's Parcel is delivered, so do not go north yet.
